description: This file defines the RoleUpdater class, which manages role updates based on feature installation/enabling/removal events within OrchardCore CMS. It handles permissions, role claims, and feature dependencies.

classes.name: RoleUpdater
classes.description: Manages role updates in response to feature lifecycle events, handling permissions and role claims.

methods.name: RoleUpdater
methods.description: Constructor initializing dependencies for role management.

methods.name: InstalledAsync
methods.description: Handles actions when a feature is installed.

methods.name: EnabledAsync
methods.description: Handles actions when a feature is enabled.

methods.name: RoleCreatedAsync
methods.description: Updates roles when a new role is created.

methods.name: RoleRemovedAsync
methods.description: Removes role data when a role is removed.

methods.name: UpdateRolesForInstalledFeatureAsync
methods.description: Updates roles based on an installed feature.

methods.name: UpdateRolesForEnabledFeatureAsync
methods.description: Updates roles when a feature is enabled.

methods.name: UpdateRoleForInstalledFeaturesAsync
methods.description: Updates a role based on installed features.

methods.name: RemoveRoleForMissingFeaturesAsync
methods.description: Removes role data for missing features.

methods.name: UpdateRolesForEnabledFeature
methods.description: Updates a role with permissions from enabled features.

methods.name: UpdatePermissions
methods.description: Adds permissions to a role if missing, excluding admin roles.
